records.text: ports/CMakeLists.txt requires a 32-bit target (CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P == 4), enables CXX for static pond3r/ggpo (mvc2_ggpo), links -Wl,--disable-dynamicbase, winhttp, ws2_32, and -Wl,-Bstatic -lstdc++ -lpthread so build-dist/mvc2dc.exe depends only on Windows system DLLs + SDL3.dll. Build with C:/msys64/mingw32/bin (gcc/g++ Ninja) and always sync build-dist via cmake --install ports/build --prefix ports/build-dist (plus patches/<id>/dc_game.dll + manifest.sig).

ports/port/sdl/start.c locates game data via SDL_GetBasePath(): roms/mvsc2 or disc (or arcade=/dc=/MVC2_ROM/MVC2_DC_DISC). Supports --config=<dir|file> (forwarding multi-arg CLI options like --p2p 3, --spectate 2, and --host-p2p 1, and defaulting to DC mode when netplay flags are passed), host_config_path() for per-instance logs/saves/replays/netplay_profile.cfg/mvc2_ipc.port, host_front_open_netplay(), and unlock = all in mvc2.cfg.

Dreamcast mode validates USA disc files via dc_disc_check() and supports optional signed patch disc overlays via dc_gd_set_overlay_dir() in ports/port/dc/dc_gd.c (1ST_READ.BIN, AICADRV.BIN, FONT.BIN, SELTEX.BIN, PL00_DAT.BIN, PL3A_DAT.BIN, STG00POL.BIN, ADX_SELC.BIN).

MVC2_FRAMES=<N> or test flags (--savestate-check, --patch-check, --replay-verify, --takeover-test, --ui-smoke-test, --synctest) activate test_run mode in main_sdl.c: SDL_HINT_WINDOW_ACTIVATE_WHEN_SHOWN=0 + SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE avoids focus stealing, no audio device is opened, software renderer rules apply unless configured gpu, frames_left pauses during --host-p2p wait (capped 20s) and while unsynchronized in netplay, and MVC2_SHOT captures overlays too.

Game code compiled for the port turns any undeclared function into a gen_host.py stub that logs 'stub: NAME' and returns 0. A macro used without its header (e.g. DEG_ANG from dm.h, not included by select.c) and libc calls such as getenv/atof in src/ silently become such stubs; check mvc2.log for 'stub:' lines.

On the select screen, sel_name.c's 'name plate' work (obj_dm01 models 177/178, texture from name_pic_set) is the character's still pose picture, a 168x215-unit quad at depth ~571 showing 184x184 texels. The live preview (select.c sel_preview_disp) projects onto its position/depth and hides it via sel_preview_shown().

Assist pillar labels: models 108 (DC/English) and 102 (Japanese) with UV templates 109/103; sel_glow_step_tbl indexes 13 type labels (0 Projectile,1 Ground,2 Expansion,3 Dash,4 Anti-air,5 Variety,6 Throw,7 Air Throw,8 Heal,9 Enhance,10 Capture,11 Launcher,12 Balance). On HOST_PORT, sel_label.c draws move name + type symbol into common texture 0xFE0 (256x512 RGB565) and retargets the label material's tcw each draw. Move names come from the character's TBL_SP_ASSIST routine plus src/sel_move_name.c, generated by tools/sel_move_names.py (--check fails when stale).

In the port, nl_obj.c stores nl_tex indices in tcw low 21 bits; put() must update near_w from nl_objput_param before returning early on rd_discard so forward rendering and GGPO rollback resimulation produce bit-identical NL_OBJ_STATE savestates.

Rollback determinism uses page-COW savestates via MEM_WRITE_WATCH (savestate.c), x86 coroutines masking SSE sticky bits with static primary stack (coro_x86.c), rd_discard suppression, board_preserve_restart() keeping mvc2.log + ram_write_watch across host_restart() (restart.c, naomi_board.c), snd_enabled() enabled for host-p2p and host_is_netplay_canonical() (snd_nl.c), pond3r/ggpo + 60f hash detail logging (ggpo_glue.c), UDP P2P listener upgrade & PUNCH!/PBACK!/R2 relay (net_transport.c), and umvsc2:// + umvc2:// protocol IPC (uri_ipc.c).

Retrocompatible patches bundle dc_game.dll + manifest.json + Ed25519 manifest.sig (sign_patch_manifest.py) verified by ed25519_verify.c + patch_dll.c BEFORE LoadLibraryA. Binary .mvc2r v1 replays (replay.c; rd_begin_frame() after host_restart() in boot_dc_match_canonical) pair with F4 Netplay/F8 Replay HUDs (http_client.c, net_ui.c) including serverless umvc2://p2p/<ip>:<port>?seed=...&patch=...&delay=... links (zero logs/server), and DC main menu Netplay item (HOME_SCORE=7 in home_menu.c, dm0c_menu.c, dc_board.c).

Super Hop: pl_hop_ck() in src/pl_sub.c eases rising superjump spd.y to 0 over HOP_STOP_FRAMES (5) after HOP_MIN_RISE (60.0f) when KEY_DOWN (1/2/3) is held/pressed, tracked in PLAYER_WORK.hop_stop_cnt (0x55d, HOP_PENDING=0x80; struct stays 0x5a4). Hooks at top of pl_sjump_ctrl() (before early returns, covering ground/chase/air-recovery/tag-in superjumps, air attacks, and air jumps) and act_jump_air() in src/pl_main.c (before pl_jump_move, skipping PL_FELICIA whose wall jump uses TBL_TJUMP). Gated on sjump_flag != 0 and !cpu_flag; hop_stop_cnt resets to 0 on landing, ground/air/wall jump starts, air recovery, hits, and tag-ins. Headless tests use ports/tools/hop_trace.ps1 (MVC2_HOP_TRACE=1, mvc2dc.exe).
